history.text: The Irigwe headquarters, west of Jos. SIM missionaries founded the Miango Rest Home here in the early 1900s. In September 2017 twenty villagers of Ancha in Miango district were killed in a reprisal attack.

livelihoods.text: Farming that supplies much of Nigeria with eggs, red pepper, maize, tomatoes, Irish and sweet potatoes, carrots, cabbage, wheat and beans.

summary.text: The Irigwe live in Bassa LGA of Plateau State, with their headquarters at Miango, and also in neighbouring Kauru LGA of Kaduna.

areas.note: Bassa LGA is shared by many peoples; Irigwe and Rukuba are the largest named.
